source.note: single-card witness of the BARE modification:evasion stem (BEHAVIOR: granting an evasion ability), the rung above the already-witnessed modification:evasion:flying leaf. Boggart Brute's only ability is Menace (oracle: 'Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)'). The parser derives it cleanly (no diagnostics): StaticAbility{ KeywordSource=Menace, Effects=[EvasionEffect{ CanBeBlockedBy=creature, MinimumBlockers=2 }] }. The live engine (PortGraph: keyword=KeywordSource -> evasion:<keyword>) projects the ADR-2 port evasion:menace; ADR-3 canonical stem = the bare modification:evasion (menace is a NON-flying evasion with no dedicated stem leaf, so it collapses to the parent, unlike flying which was promoted to modification:evasion:flying). A faithful witness, not a wish. AXIS QUESTION: there is no closed attribute axis for the evasion sub-kind (menace / fear / intimidate / can't-be-blocked). Following the modification:evasion:flying sibling convention (it carries only subject; the kind lives in the stem), this gold witnesses the bare stem with subject:self only and does NOT invent an evasion-kind key. The scaffold question (should evasion sub-kinds get stem leaves like :flying, or a closed axis?) is surfaced, not decided.

Boggart Brute.note: THE WITNESS — Menace (CR 702.111a: 'Menace is an evasion ability'). A self-modification static keyword: the creature grants itself the evasion. AST-derivable: StaticAbility.KeywordSource=Menace + EvasionEffect{MinimumBlockers=2} -> engine emits evasion:menace -> hand-maps to the bare modification:evasion (no :menace stem leaf, no closed evasion-kind axis).

assertions.because: M0 projects the bare BEHAVIOR stem modification:evasion (parent of the witnessed modification:evasion:flying leaf), derived from the Menace static keyword; menace is a non-flying evasion with no dedicated stem leaf, so it is the smallest honest witness of the parent rung
menace is the creature's OWN static keyword (a self-modification); subject axis, value self — matching the modification:evasion:flying sibling convention

the live engine projects ADR-2 evasion:menace, but the evasion sub-kind (menace) is captured by neither a stem leaf nor a closed attribute axis; recorded in the note as an open scaffold question, not invented as an ad-hoc attrs key
